Subject Mr. Heinrich SALOMON
CONFIDENTIAL
DRAWER
（批：2/26/44）

Made by and Forwarded by Inspector Papp.

（左侧手写批注：FILE / [签名] / Confidential / drawer）

Enquiries made concerning one Mr. Heinrich
SALOMON, a German refugee ascertained the following:-

Mr. Heinrich Salomon, German Jew, married,
was born in Berlin on February 26, 1880. Accompanied
by his wife and daughter, he arrived in Shanghai on
board the s.s. "Conte Verde" on April 3, 1939, travelling
1st class with ticket number S. 76/No. 342.

Following his arrival, he put up with his
family at Room 23 of the Astor House Hotel, where he
stayed from April 5 to May 5, 1939. On May 6, 1939 he
removed with his family to foreign lodging house at 472
Kinchow Road, where he is living now.

It is reported that Mr. Heinrich Salomon
was the manager and part-owner of a Liquor and Spirits
Factory named Heinrich Faerber and Sohn in Berlin. He
joined the above firm immediately after his return from
the front in 1918 and remained with them until
November 1938, when the firm was sequestrated by the
German Government.

According to information he is said to have
had no trouble with the German Authorities, but he left
Germany owing to the persecution of the Jews in that
country. He claims to have fought in the war with
distinction, having obtained the Iron Cross for his bravery
and was wounded once. Owing to the persecution of the
Jews, however, he feels now great resentment and enmity
towards Germany and is prepared to do anything to over-
throw the present regime in his native country.

经对一名名为海因里希·萨洛蒙 (Heinrich SALOMON) 的德国难民进行调查，查明情况如下：

海因里希·萨洛蒙 (Heinrich Salomon) 先生，德籍犹太人，已婚，1880年2月26日出生于柏林。1939年4月3日，他携妻子和女儿乘坐“康特·维尔德”号 (s.s. "Conte Verde") 轮船抵达上海，持有一等舱船票，票号为 S. 76/第342号。

抵达后，他与家人入住礼查饭店 (Astor House Hotel) 23号房间，居住时间为1939年4月5日至5月5日。1939年5月6日，他携家人搬至锦州路472号的外侨公寓，目前居住于此。

据报，海因里希·萨洛蒙 (Heinrich Salomon) 先生曾是柏林一家名为“海因里希·法贝尔父子” (Heinrich Faerber and Sohn) 的酒类与烈酒工厂的经理及部分所有者。他于1918年从前线返回后立即加入上述公司，并一直任职至1938年11月，当时该公司被德国政府没收。

据其所称信息，他表示自己未曾与德国当局发生冲突，但因该国迫害犹太人而离开德国。他声称在战争中表现英勇，曾因勇敢获得铁十字勋章，并负伤一次。然而，由于遭受对犹太人的迫害，他目前对德国怀有强烈的怨恨和敌意，并准备采取任何行动以推翻其祖国的现政权。
